name: Serendip
tagline: Zap through films like TV channels.
summary: One film per screen, a trailer already playing, picks from outside your usual loop.

highlights.label: ZAPPING
highlights.title: One film per screen
highlights.text: Up and down to zap, left and right to change channel.

highlights.label: TONIGHT
highlights.title: Only what streams in Spain
highlights.text: Picks come from your own services, with a one-line reason.

highlights.label: OUTSIDE
highlights.title: Out of your usual loop
highlights.text: Every third pick leaves your usual genres and countries.

highlights.label: TASTE
highlights.title: Bring your history
highlights.text: Import a Letterboxd export or a Netflix viewing history.

highlights.label: DETOUR
highlights.title: Daily YouTube detours
highlights.text: Twelve videos a day from fields you rarely watch.

highlights.label: AGENTS
highlights.title: JSON and MCP
highlights.text: Agents read tonight's picks from an API or an MCP server.

steps.title: Set up
steps.text: Pick services, languages and loved films.

steps.title: Import
steps.text: Add Letterboxd, Netflix or YouTube history.

steps.title: Rank
steps.text: Deterministic scoring, a reason on every pick.

steps.title: Zap
steps.text: Open /tv and use the remote or touch.

steps.title: Log
steps.text: Record what you watched and how long you chose.
